about: raven_1 in flight, from Tripo (Moti's flytd.glb, from an edited picture of the same raven gliding toward the camera): wings spread level, the primaries apart like fingers, the tail fanned, legs tucked, the head turned a little; it came yawed 14.5 deg off -Y (turn -14.5 sets it straight). One shell, 5 open edges. 0.62 m beak to tail like raven_1 (about 1.04 m across the wings). The game swaps raven_1 for it at the take-off's spring.
